description: A grand, classically detailed stairwell foyer with a sweeping curved staircase ascending in a wide elegant arc from the lower floor. The curved inner wall of the staircase is smooth white plaster and the outer wall is entirely covered in elaborate white applied panel moulding in a traditional Georgian or French classical pattern — large recessed rectangular panels within a framework of profiled bolection and flat mouldings, rising two full stories. A large multi-pane sash window with white painted surrounds sits at the landing, flooding the stairwell with bright natural daylight. The stair treads are rich dark walnut-stained hardwood with a plain white painted newel and baluster system. At the lower level, a classical white marble fireplace mantel with carved surround is partially visible at the lower left, its firebox glowing with orange flame. The floor at the base is herringbone parquet in a warm medium honey-toned wood. Suspended through the center of the stairwell void, a dramatic cascading cluster of individual woven wicker or rattan cylindrical basket-form elements hangs at staggered heights from a single central attachment point at the ceiling high above, creating a vertical sculptural column that descends through two full floors. Each cylindrical basket element glows warmly from within with amber candlelight-toned illumination, creating a rich dappled amber glow pattern across the white plaster stair walls and illuminating the stairwell in warm, textural tones. Camera at standing eye-level, wide lens, centered view looking across the stairwell from the opposite side of the curve. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
